title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Southern Methodist University
description: A current, under-21-safe mix of late food stops and campus destinations with published evening hours.

cards.title: Zalat Pizza — Snider Plaza
cards.subtitle: 6935 Hillcrest Ave, Dallas
cards.notes: Use the Snider Plaza location for a pickup run; confirm its current hours before leaving, especially on weekends and holidays.
cards.short_summary: Pizza pickup remains available through midnight most weekdays and until 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Zalat lists this Snider Plaza location open until midnight Monday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Thu 11 a.m.–12 a.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–4 a.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Hours may change.

cards.title: Velvet Taco — Greenville
cards.subtitle: 4622 Greenville Ave, Dallas
cards.notes: Plan a food-only stop at the Greenville restaurant and check the day-specific closing time before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: This Dallas taco location publishes service as late as 3 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco lists its Greenville location open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday, midnight Thursday, and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Sun–Wed 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; Thu to 12 a.m.; Fri–Sat to 3 a.m. Confirm holiday changes.

cards.title: Oishii — SMU Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 5627 SMU Boulevard, Dallas
cards.notes: Choose an early-evening meal near campus; Friday and Saturday service runs later than the standard weekday dinner window.
cards.short_summary: The SMU Boulevard restaurant lists dinner service through 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Oishii lists its SMU Boulevard location open until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours include dinner to 10 p.m. Sun–Thu and to 11 p.m. Fri–Sat; the restaurant notes holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: IHOP — North Central Expressway
cards.subtitle: 7830 N. Central Expy, Dallas
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check services, then choose dine-in, takeout, or online ordering for an any-hour food stop.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP with published late-night food, dine-in, takeout, delivery, and Wi-Fi amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists the 7830 N. Central Expressway restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies it as offering late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: open 24 hours Monday–Sunday. The location page lists late-night food, dine-in, takeout, delivery, and Wi-Fi.

cards.title: Whataburger — Haskell & Capitol
cards.subtitle: 2428 N. Haskell Ave, Dallas
cards.notes: Treat this as an off-campus food option; use the location page for directions and verify holiday changes before heading out.
cards.short_summary: The official Dallas locator lists this Haskell Avenue location as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its Haskell & Capitol restaurant at 2428 N. Haskell Ave as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Published hours for Whataburger #728, Haskell & Capitol: open 24 hours daily; holiday hours may differ.

cards.entity_name: Anita and Truman Arnold Dining Commons
cards.title: Arnold Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: SMU campus, Dallas
cards.notes: Check the dining schedule and arrive before dinner service ends; this is a campus option rather than an after-midnight stop.
cards.short_summary: SMU’s facility-hours page lists Arnold Dining Commons open as late as 9 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Anita and Truman Arnold Dining Commons as occupied from 5 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday–Friday.
cards.access_notes: Published building hours: Monday–Friday 5 a.m.–9 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 5 a.m.–7 p.m. Dining access may depend on SMU eligibility.

cards.title: Hughes-Trigg Student Center
cards.subtitle: SMU main campus, Dallas
cards.notes: Use the student center for an evening study, meeting, or social stop, and leave enough time before the weekday building close.
cards.short_summary: SMU identifies Hughes-Trigg as a campus hub for eating, studying, socializing, and student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Hughes-Trigg Student Center building hours of 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday.
cards.source_title: Hughes-Trigg Student Center — SMU Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Published building hours: Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sat–Sun 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Individual services may keep different hours.

cards.title: Dedman Center for Lifetime Sports
cards.subtitle: 6000 Bush Ave, Dallas
cards.notes: Schedule a late workout or recreation session during fall and spring semesters; review entry rules and any upcoming hour changes first.
cards.short_summary: SMU’s recreation center stays open until 11 p.m. on Monday–Thursday and Sunday during regular semesters.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Dedman Center fall/spring hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Dedman Center for Lifetime Sports — SMU Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Fall/spring published hours: Mon–Thu 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri–Sat to 10 p.m.; Sun 1–11 p.m. Access is for students, members, or eligible guests.

cards.title: Bridwell Library
cards.subtitle: SMU campus, Dallas
cards.notes: Use the library for a late weekday research or reading session, and check its schedule for holidays, breaks, and service-desk timing.
cards.short_summary: SMU’s facilities page lists Bridwell Library open until 11:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Bridwell Library as occupied from 5 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published building hours: Mon–Thu 5 a.m.–11:30 p.m.; Fri to 6:30 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.–6:30 p.m.; Sun 1–10:30 p.m. Check library access rules.

cards.title: Umphrey Lee Center
cards.subtitle: SMU campus, Dallas
cards.notes: Use the non-kitchen first-floor area for an evening campus stop; verify individual dining and event-space schedules separately.
cards.short_summary: SMU lists the non-kitchen first floor open until 10 p.m. every day, later than the kitchen area.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Umphrey Lee Center’s non-kitchen first floor as occupied until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Published non-kitchen first-floor hours: 7 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. The kitchen has earlier hours, so confirm food availability independently.
